markdown:
Source: Player's Handbook (Glyph of Warding)

*3rd-level protection*

**Casting Time:** 1 hour

**Range:** Touch

**Components:** V, S, M ($$20,000 worth of electronics and materials, which the tech consumes)

**Duration:** Until dissipated or triggered

When you cast this tech, you create a device that creates a technical effect triggered by other creatures, either upon a surface (such as a table or a section of floor or wall) or within an object that can be closed (such as a book, a locker, or a treasure chest) to conceal the device. The device can cover an area no larger than 10 feet in diameter. If the surface or object is moved more than 10 feet from where you cast this tech, the device is broken, and the tech ends without being triggered.

The device is nearly invisible and requires a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your tech save DC to be found.

You decide what triggers the device when you cast the tech. For devices inscribed on a surface, the most typical triggers include touching or standing on the device, removing another object covering the device, approaching within a certain distance of the device, or manipulating the object on which the device is inscribed. For devices inscribed within an object, the most common triggers include opening that object, approaching within a certain distance of the object, or seeing or reading the device. Once a device is triggered, this tech ends.

You can further refine the trigger so the tech activates only under certain circumstances or according to physical characteristics (such as height or weight), creature kind (for example, the ward could be set to affect aberrations or drow), or alignment. You can also set conditions for creatures that don’t trigger the device, such as those who say a certain password.

When you create the device, choose explosive device or a tech device.

***Explosive Device.*** When triggered, the device erupts with explosive energy in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the device. The sphere spreads around corners. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 5d8 acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage on a failed saving throw (your choice when you create the device), or half as much damage on a successful one.

***Tech Device.*** You can store a prepared tech of 3rd level or lower in the device by casting it as part of creating the device. The tech must target a single creature or an area. The tech being stored has no immediate effect when cast in this way. When the device is triggered, the stored tech is cast. If the tech has a target, it targets the creature that triggered the device. If the tech affects an area, the area is centered on that creature. If the tech summons hostile creatures or creates harmful objects or traps, they appear as close as possible to the intruder and attack it. If the tech requires concentration, it lasts until the end of its full duration.

***At Higher Levels.*** When you cast this tech using a tech slot of 4th level or higher, the damage of an explosive device increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd. If you create a tech device, you can store any tech of up to the same level as the slot you use for the booby trap.

***Tech Lists.*** [Influencer](/techs:influencer), [Mechanist](/techs:mechanist), [Ordinator](/techs:ordinator), [Techwizard](/techs:techwizard)
